children: Adidas is executing well in a mixed environment for sports goods, driven by its decentralized business model, RBC analysts write. "Adidas is being run differently today--and since 2023--with a multi-season cycle and mid-term approach which we believe is the right one," the analysts say. Quarterly earnings may disappoint in the meantime, with revenue growth to decelerate after a strong first half, they add. RBC has an outperform rating on the stock and 200-euro price target. Shares are 2.4% higher at 145.65 euros but down 14% over the year to date. (joseph.wilkins@wsj.com)
